The '''Holosseum''' was a large concert venue in [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Holostar]] [[Javul Charn]] performed three concerts there during her tour of [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. It was made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] and shaped like half of an egg. It was spacious enough to hold at least 5 [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]].
